meta.title: 职场想要什么：完全取决于你自己
meta.title_en: What You Want at Work Is Entirely Up to You

scenes.context: 讲者指出「你怎么可能不关注公司发展」本质上是一个人生观和世界观的问题——每个人关心什么是完全主观的，北京与南京的生活选择没有对错。
sentences: 你怎么可能不关注公司发展呢？
How could you possibly not care about the company's growth?
怎么可能：how could you possibly
你愿意在北京生活，我愿意在南京生活，这东西没有对错。
You prefer living in Beijing, I prefer Nanjing; there is no right or wrong here.
愿意：prefer / choose to
职场也是一样，你想获得什么完全取决于你。
Work is the same — what you want out of it is entirely up to you.
完全取决于你：entirely up to you
paraphrase: 追问关注公司发展 → 深挖到人生观
Caring about the company leads back to one's worldview.
北京 vs 南京 → 没有对错
Choosing Beijing or Nanjing is neither right nor wrong.
scenes.speak: How could you possibly not care about the company's growth? You prefer living in Beijing, I prefer Nanjing; there is no right or wrong here. Work is the same — what you want out of it is entirely up to you.

scenes.context: 讲者列举不同人的职场追求：有人只为混一份工资、谁给钱给谁干；有人是房二代出来上班就是玩一下；有人只要烟钱和打游戏的钱。
sentences: 我来职场就是为了混一份工资，谁给我发工资我就给谁干。
I'm here just for a paycheck — I'll work for whoever pays me.
混一份工资：work just for a paycheck
他家里是房二代，出来上班就是玩一下。
He comes from a landlord family and just works for fun.
房二代：from a landlord family
他只要有个烟钱、有个打游戏的钱就行了。
He only needs pocket money for cigarettes and video games.
烟钱：pocket money for cigarettes
paraphrase: 混工资 → 谁给钱给谁干
A paycheck mindset: work for whoever pays.
房二代 → 上班是玩一下
A privileged kid treats work as entertainment.
scenes.speak: I'm here just for a paycheck — I'll work for whoever pays me. He comes from a landlord family and just works for fun. He only needs pocket money for cigarettes and video games.

scenes.title_cn: 想要更多价值就要加入组织
scenes.title_en: Want more value? Join an organization
scenes.context: 讲者点出：如果真想在职场获得更多收入与影响力，因为个人太渺小，就必须加入某个组织——公司或政府组织，借组织放大自己的影响力。
sentences: 如果你想在职场获得更多价值，比如一年能有上百万的收入。
If you want more value at work — say, a seven-figure annual income.
上百万的收入：a seven-figure income
我们个人太渺小，想对社会产生更大的影响，就必须加入某个组织。
We individuals are too small; to impact society more, we must join an organization.
个人太渺小：individuals are too small
加入商业公司彰显存在的方式，就是为这个社会提供更优的产品和服务。
In a company, you make your mark by serving society with better products and services.
彰显存在：make your mark
paraphrase: 想要更多价值 → 收入与影响力
Wanting more value means income and influence.
个人渺小 → 借组织放大
When individuals are small, organizations amplify them.
scenes.speak: If you want more value at work — say, a seven-figure annual income. We individuals are too small; to impact society more, we must join an organization. In a company, you make your mark by serving society with better products and services.

practice: What you want from your career is entirely up to you.
说「给谁发工资就给谁干」
I'll work for whoever pays me.
表达「借组织放大影响力」
Choosing Beijing or Nanjing is neither right nor wrong.
pitfalls: ✕ 直译腔：You must care about the company.
✓ 地道说法：How could you possibly not care about the company?
用反问 how could you possibly 比直陈更有口语味道。
✕ 直译腔：He has a second-generation room.
✓ 地道说法：He comes from a landlord family.
房二代翻译要意译为 landlord family。
✕ 直译腔：I want to get a million dollars.
✓ 地道说法：I want a seven-figure income.
用 seven-figure income 比直译更自然。
✕ 直译腔：The individual is very small.
✓ 地道说法：Individuals are too small to matter alone.
补上 to matter alone 语义才完整。
shifts: 把「不关注公司」当作不敬业
把它当作「不同的世界观选择」
把职场追求看作统一标准
承认追求完全主观、没有对错
认识到借组织放大影响力的必要性
footer_notes: ASR 专有名词已按语境校正（如「混一份工资」按上下文校正）。场景/句子朗读使用 edge-tts，单词发音使用浏览器 Web Speech API。
